text: The observatory team reached the ridge before sunrise. A thin mist drifted through the valley, and the last stars faded above the western hills. Mira checked the instrument cases while Daniel unfolded a paper map. Neither wanted to hurry the calibration. The measurements would guide tomorrow’s survey, so each reading had to be written down carefully. After a short break, they aligned the telescope and waited for the first clear view. A distant bell rang from the village below. Mira smiled, opened her notebook, and began the final checklist.
